title: QA verdict record v1
description: One platform's QA verdict, pinned to the tested head SHA and the installed artifact. One record per platform: one platform's PASS never covers the other. core/tools/qa_freshness.py validates records, renders the PR comment and decides freshness and the PR label.

recordedBy.description: The QA lane or session that recorded the verdict

evidence.description: The qa_evidence.py row or run this result rests on; required for PASS

carriedFrom.description: NOT_RUN only: the earlier head whose result on this platform carries over (rerun_scope.py)

knownIssue.description: FAIL only: the tracked issue that makes this failure a known exception

carry.description: Carry records: for each earlier head whose results this record carries over, the two SHAs and every path of `git diff --no-renames --name-only <from>..<to>`, run by the QA lane itself and equal to rerun_scope.py's `changedPaths` (sorted). Required for carried rows in strict carry mode.
